ctbids-48681-5696693.description:
Set of six antique Irish sterling silver spoons bearing traditional Dublin hallmarks.

The spoons display period Irish silver marks including the crowned harp sterling standard mark and Hibernia/Dublin assay mark. The crowned harp was historically used to denote the sterling silver standard of .925 fineness in Dublin.

Several handles are additionally engraved with a detailed stag/deer head crest, likely representing a heraldic or family crest.

The individual hallmarks show varying degrees of wear from age. Maker and exact date have not been confirmed.

Includes:
6 sterling silver spoons

Approx. dimensions:
Approximately 8" L each.
Please see measurement photos for additional details.

Total weight:
Approx. 186 grams for all 6 spoons combined.

Condition:
Antique pre-owned condition with surface scratches, tarnish, oxidation, rubbing, worn hallmarks, and other age-related wear. Several handles feature engraved stag/deer crests.
Please review all photos closely for individual hallmarks, engravings, measurements, weight, and condition.

282958798.description:
Raw Selenite Crystal Specimen
Natural Satin Spar Gypsum Bar
Earth Science & Mineral Specimen
This natural raw selenite crystal specimen showcases the characteristic parallel fibrous structure and pearlescent chatoyant sheen of satin spar gypsum. The elongated tabular formation displays distinct linear striations running longitudinally along the crystal face, accompanied by naturally cleaved ends and authentic matrix rock inclusions. Ideal as a geological study piece, display rock, or altar meditation stone.
Natural satin spar selenite gypsum mineral specimen
Characteristic fibrous crystal growth showing silky chatoyant luster
Untreated rough bar formation with natural cleavage planes and minor matrix inclusions
Measures approximately 5.75 inches long, 2 inches wide, 1.5 inches high; weighs 1.5 lbs
Condition:
Good natural specimen condition. Structurally solid formation with raw cleaved terminations. Typical geological surface roughness, natural fiber cleavage, and minor adhered matrix material present as shown.

282666111.description:
A.C. Gilbert Co.
Metal Microscope Set in Hinged Tin Case
Mid-Century, Circa 1950s
Produced by the renowned A.C. Gilbert Company of New Haven, Connecticut, this vintage No. 9 Microscope Set represents an iconic era of mid-century educational science toys. Housed in its original grey enameled hinged metal carry case with lithographed label, the set features a three-turret optical microscope equipped with a Ramsden eye lens and reflector mirror. Accompanying the instrument are period laboratory accessories including chemical specimen vials, slide boxes, and two original instructional booklets from the Gilbert Hall of Science.
Enameled sheet metal carrying case with handle, latch, and internal fold-out specimen rack
Marked "No. 9 GILBERT MICROSCOPE SET" with stated area magnification ratings up to 105,625 times
Includes three-objective microscope, test tubes with vintage reagents, slide container, spot plate, and two booklets ("How to Use the Gilbert Microscope" and "Gilbert Glass Blowing")
Measures approximately 13.75" high by 9.5" wide by 5" deep; weighs 7.0 lbs
Condition:
Vintage used condition. The microscope frame is structurally sound with intact stage clips and focusing knobs. Metal case exhibits surface scuffs, scratches, oxidation spots, and exterior decal wear consistent with age and storage. Chemical tubes show varying fill levels, dried residues, and aged labels; booklets have edge wear, handling creases, and light toning. Partial set with some empty accessory slots.
